raw.query: SELECT model, mode, candidate, mae, rmse, wape, h FROM provenance.forecast_metrics WHERE LOWER(model) LIKE '%ewma%' OR LOWER(mode) LIKE '%ewma%'  -- plus: SELECT resolution, variate, 100.0*avg(CASE WHEN y_true <= p90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM provenance.forecast_ewma GROUP BY resolution, variate
raw.observed: forecast_metrics holds only mae/rmse/wape per percentile candidate (no coverage/calibration column); computable p90 one-sided coverage from forecast_ewma = 89.84%-96.97% across variates/resolutions, mostly >=0.90 (median ~0.93)
raw.evidence: The owning view forecast_metrics contains no coverage metric, so the '0.88-0.90 coverage' figure cannot be checked against its stated backing; the only recoverable coverage (forecast_ewma) exceeds the claimed 0.90 ceiling for most variates (up to 0.9697) and no '1.4-day context' subset is isolated to rescue it.
raw.fix: Add a coverage/calibration column (empirical p90 coverage per variate/resolution/context) to forecast_metrics, or point the claim at the forecast_ewma-derived coverage table and specify exactly which context/hyperparameter subset yields 0.88-0.90.
